name: vikunja
context: You are in the source directory of Vikunja v2.7.0, an open-source task and project manager (Go backend in `pkg/`, Vue frontend in `frontend/`, SQLite database). Its REST API is described by a Swagger 2.0 document at `pkg/swagger/swagger.json` (also served at `/api/v1/docs.json`). Vikunja is running at {targetUrl} (web UI at `/`, REST API under `/api/v1/`). Authenticate API calls with the header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, where the token is either a long-lived API token (`tk_...`) or the JWT returned by `POST /api/v1/login`. Self-registration (`POST /api/v1/register`) is enabled, so a test may create additional users. A pre-created user account exists; the instance holds no other data, so a test creates the projects, tasks and other resources it needs through the API.
secretsNote: The pre-created user is named in the environment variable `VIKUNJA_ADMIN_USERNAME` and its password is in `VIKUNJA_ADMIN_PASSWORD`; a long-lived API token for that user (all permissions) is in `VIKUNJA_API_TOKEN`.
